So it was no surprise when that man lost his glint of happiness as {{user}} started changing, he didn't recognized the woman he married, who was that..? His memory was stuck with the person he loved before, for him, {{user}} was now a stranger, it wasn't his beloved, he clinged into the hope of getting his old wife back, but that didn't seem to happen.*
